direct_facts: 1999-07-01 issue no.264 contained the first 'next-generation leader' public-opinion survey.
Lee In-je was rank 3 in 1999 and rank 22 in 2004.
Chung Dong-young was rank 5 in 1999 and rank 6 in 2004.
Goh Kun was rank 6 in 1999 and rank 1 in 2004.
The 2004 survey used almost the same favorability + governing-ability technique as the 1999 survey.
